description: Header file defining the PrioritizedDispatcher class, which manages job dispatching based on priority with limits on concurrent jobs. Includes nested classes, methods for adding, canceling, changing priority, and managing limits.

classes.name: PrioritizedDispatcher
classes.description: Manages priority-based job dispatching with limits on concurrent jobs.

classes.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::Job
classes.description: Interface for jobs managed by the dispatcher; must implement Start() method.

classes.name: PrioritizedDispatcher::Limits
classes.description: Structure defining limits on total jobs and reserved slots per priority.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a job with specified priority; starts immediately if limits allow.

methods.name: AddAtHead
methods.description: Adds a job at the front of the queue for its priority.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Removes a job from the queue using its handle.

methods.name: EvictOldestLowest
methods.description: Removes and returns the oldest lowest-priority job.

methods.name: ChangePriority
methods.description: Changes the priority of a queued job.

methods.name: OnJobFinished
methods.description: Notifies dispatcher that a job has completed, possibly starting new jobs.

methods.name: GetLimits
methods.description: Retrieves current limits on job dispatching.

methods.name: SetLimits
methods.description: Updates limits and starts jobs if permitted.

methods.name: SetLimitsToZero
methods.description: Disallows starting new jobs by setting limits to zero.
